name: Toyota 1HD-FT (intercooled)
notes: The intercooled 1995-97 update to the HDJ80's turbo-diesel (a notable power step up from the earlier 1HD-T) - not set as hdj80/hdj81's primary stock_engine here since that's mapped to the more common 1990-94 1HD-T for simplicity, but later-production units of both frames used this engine. Naming is genuinely ambiguous in sources - some call this exact intercooled engine '1HD-FTE' instead, blurring the line with the electronically-controlled engine already seeded separately; marked mechanical here per Toyota's usual T/TE suffix convention, but treat that as a judgment call, not a confirmed fact.
